Usage: ocfl delete --id=STRING [flags]

Delete an object in the storage root

Flags:
  -h, --help           Show context-sensitive help.
      --root=STRING    The prefix/directory of the OCFL storage root used for
                       the command ($OCFL_ROOT)
      --debug          enable debug log messages

  -i, --id=STRING      The ID for the object to delete
  -y, --yes            skip delete confirmation.
      --not-object     skip check that files for ID are those of an OCFL object.
